items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: I've got a little 20 year old Jewish boy, Don Reinberg, I'll never forget him.

ctx.x: Everything -- everybody's in here. So now I go to rehearsal and I play, and I found out, well, I've got to brush up a little. I've got a little 20 year old Jewish boy, Don Reinberg, I'll never forget him. This guy could play the thing down like he'd been playing it for years. He just got out of the Army, and his father was a cellist in Seattle -- no, in San Francisco. And he could play this legit music, oh, God. He'd run down it, and he'd get a little frightened on the high notes, but otherwise, he was straight.…
